name: biblio-downloaded-epub-v1

provenance.bug: BiblioBook only recognized a downloaded EPUB through the CURRENT live source inventory. When the source vanished / reordered / returned a different md5, the detail page forgot the durable local book and tried another acquisition. Healed by 38339f4 ("fix(biblio): stabilize downloaded book read journey"): refreshLocal() now scans Books.downloadedBooks() and matches normalized title+author (BiblioApi.pairKey) so the already-downloaded copy is recovered independent of live sources, and openBookSession/routeDownloadItem make the local path the session target id while preserving title+author.

note: The seed-sensitive healed state (BookDownloader self-heals the stale books/index.json path to <AppData>/books/tiny-book.epub, so the durable book appears in Downloads and the detail page resolves localPath from downloadedBooks() with an empty live source inventory) is proven by the scenario's own assertions (biblioBookDetail.localPath, biblioPrimaryReadStatus, downloadsShelfCard_biblio_*, bookReaderShell.bookPath), because no AVAILABLE bridge command reads the Books index directly. bootSplash.visible==false is the only seed-independent boot-time waitable, matching the founding vault-stale-index-v1 seed's honest precedent. collection-store.ini: the ONE-TIME boot backfill that would surface a downloaded book in the Biblio Library runs against ProfileStoreRuntime's SEALED placeholder (a QTemporaryDir-backed Collection created at boot, before onboarding) and its writes are DISCARDED when the user picks 'continue local' and the store rebinds to the durable <AppData>/collection-store.ini (verified 2026-08-27: the durable store is empty after onboarding, so the Library card never renders). That backfill-vs-account-runtime interaction is a pre-existing gap OUTSIDE 38339f4's fence, so this seed carries the durable Collection entry directly (the exact durable state the bug ran against: one biblio entry whose payload.book = {title:'Arc 19 Book', author:'Test Author'}) to make the deterministic Library entry route reachable. The fix's own contracts (refreshLocal downloadedBooks fallback, path session identity) are still exercised live; only the incidental backfill-to-Library hop is supplied by the seed.
